value.name: Asha questions Lucia's offering
value.description: Asha turns to Lucia and quietly asks what she has brought them, signaling that Lucia has arrived with something important.
evidence: Asha did not lift her wrist from the page yet; she only turned her head, slowly, until she had Lucia's eyes, and asked under her breath what she had brought them.

value.name: Lucia hesitates at the room's threshold
value.description: Lucia stops just inside the room, clutching something against her chest while weighing how to respond to the adults.
evidence: Lucia stopped a pace inside the room, her fingers tightening over the shape against her sternum, and looked at Asha and then at the cooling cup on the tray as if deciding which of the two adults in the room she was answering.

value.name: Rosa silently pressures Lucia
value.description: Rosa keeps her hand on Lucia's shoulder without speaking, using quiet physical pressure to guide her.
evidence: Rosa kept her hand where it was on Lucia's shoulder and said nothing, which was its own kind of pressure

value.name: Asha invites Lucia to present the paper
value.description: Asha opens her hand on the desk and leaves the folded sheet visible, signaling that Lucia is being asked rather than forced.
evidence: Asha lifted her wrist from the page, slowly, and turned her palm up on the desk between them, an open hand without reach in it, the folded sheet still tucked at her cuff so Lucia could see she was being asked and not stripped.

value.name: Rosa nudges Lucia forward
value.description: Rosa presses Lucia's shoulder, prompting her to move closer to the desk.
evidence: Rosa felt the girl hesitate under her hand and pressed her fingers once at the back of Lucia's shoulder, the small steady pressure of someone who had walked her through worse rooms, and Lucia took the half-step forward almost without meaning to

value.name: Lucia approaches the desk reluctantly
value.description: Lucia edges up to the desk while still clutching her blouse, torn between Asha's open hand and the cup beside it.
evidence: Lucia took the half-step forward almost without meaning to, her other hand still flattened over the cloth of her blouse.
For a moment she only stood there at the edge of the desk, looking at Asha's open palm and then at the cooling cup beside it

value.name: Lucia reveals the folded paper
value.description: Lucia pulls a folded paper from beneath her blouse and places it on the desk beside Asha.
evidence: Then Lucia drew the folded paper out from under her blouse, the edge of it warm and creased into the shape of her ribs, and set it down on the desk beside Asha's wrist
